actions.mechanism: Separate the original selection from its current attachment so migration never overwrites the reader's source.
actions.implementation: Store original text, revision ID, range, surrounding context, and a reference to an immutable revision snapshot; keep later attachments separately.
actions.check: After successive edits and migrations, opening the original highlight must reproduce its original text and revision.
actions.risk: Revision retention increases storage and requires explicit deletion policies.

actions.action: Track passage identity through editor operations
actions.mechanism: Persistent passage IDs and recorded edit operations distinguish moves from copies without relying on textual similarity.
actions.implementation: Preserve IDs on moves, assign new IDs on copies, and record split or merge ancestry. Flag edits intersecting highlighted text for review.
actions.check: Moving a paragraph preserves its note and operation history; duplicating it does not duplicate or redirect the attachment.
actions.risk: Imported revisions may lack trustworthy identity or operation history.

actions.action: Find moved passages across the entire document
actions.mechanism: Whole-document exact search finds relocation candidates that a local offset search would miss, while preserving occurrence distinctions.
actions.implementation: Index exact selected text and surrounding blocks across sections. Record every occurrence, section path, and context comparison; require confirmation without reliable identity evidence.
actions.check: A moved paragraph appears among candidates; identical repeated sentences remain separate candidates rather than collapsing into one.
actions.risk: Textual uniqueness alone cannot prove historical passage identity.

actions.action: Make uncertainty a first-class attachment state
actions.mechanism: Explicit states prevent a candidate ranking or search failure from masquerading as a verified attachment.
actions.implementation: Use verified, pending-review, ambiguous, unresolved, and deleted states. Similarity search may suggest candidates but cannot commit attachments; display competing candidates without a default selection.
actions.check: Repeated sentences yield ambiguity without identity evidence; changing 'must' to 'may' cannot silently produce a verified attachment.
actions.risk: Conservative rules can increase the reader's review workload.

actions.action: Provide contextual comparison before accepting changed passages
actions.mechanism: Side-by-side revision views let readers inspect wording and context before deciding whether a note still applies.
actions.implementation: Show original and proposed passages with revision labels, section paths, surrounding paragraphs, and exact additions and deletions. Offer accept, choose another, or leave unattached.
actions.check: A one-word negation change remains visible; rejecting the proposal leaves the note and original source unchanged.
actions.risk: Narrow excerpts can conceal meaning changes in surrounding material.

actions.action: Keep deleted passages as readable note anchors
actions.mechanism: An unattached historical anchor preserves useful notes without pretending their source still exists in the current document.
actions.implementation: Display an unavailable-source card containing the original passage, revision link, and unchanged notes. Mark deletion only with operation evidence or user confirmation; otherwise label unresolved.
actions.check: Deleting a highlighted passage leaves its notes searchable and readable, with no current-document attachment.
actions.risk: Incomplete matching could otherwise mislabel a moved passage as deleted.

actions.action: Record and reverse every attachment decision
actions.mechanism: An append-only decision history makes retained notes traceable and permits correction without modifying their original source.
actions.implementation: Record old and new revision ranges, matching evidence, decision method, and user approval where applicable. Add undo that restores the previous attachment state.
actions.check: For a retained moved-paragraph note, inspect its evidence and undo the attachment; original text and note content must remain intact.
actions.risk: Evidence records must remain accessible alongside retained revisions.

actions.action: Test attachment behavior with adversarial revision fixtures
actions.mechanism: Expected attachment states expose unsafe transfers independently of whether a search algorithm returns plausible-looking passages.
actions.implementation: Create fixtures for identical repeated sentences, paragraph moves, negation edits, deletion, and copy-then-delete. Assert candidate ranges, attachment states, preserved sources, and decision evidence.
actions.check: Run fixtures in continuous integration; fail on unexpected automatic attachment, lost notes, hidden ambiguity, or missing original revision data.
actions.risk: Passing fixtures does not establish reliability on every document.
